tldr: Wealthsimple dominated the news with its 'Wealthsimple Presents' launch of 12 products, including the Penny AI assistant, instant $100K transfers and the CADD stablecoin. BMO and Chime are also putting agentic AI into service and personal finance, while Nubank and Mercado Pago paused crypto transfers after an external provider failure.
themes: Agentic AI in banking apps and service
Wealthsimple's push into everyday banking and trading

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple launches Penny, an AI assistant that prepares e-transfers, invoice payments, trades and duplicate-charge flags. It requires client confirmation before acting, and ChatGPT and Claude connections are planned.
highlights.why: This is the most direct competitor move on AI in a Canadian app. The confirm-before-acting design sets a UX and trust benchmark for any Simplii assistant.

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple Pay (instant transfers up to $100K between clients, live now), temporary virtual cards, commission-free options on Canadian stocks, and Wealthsimple Pro (late November).
highlights.why: Wealthsimple is widening from investing into payments and active trading. Simplii should check its own transfer limits, virtual card options and trading fee positioning against these.

highlights.headline: Wealthsimple announces CADD, a CAD-backed stablecoin with a 3.25% annual reward, plus a no-FX-fee, 1% cash back business credit card for early 2027 and a rebuilt native app.
highlights.why: A 3.25% reward on a stablecoin adds pressure on savings yields. The no-FX-fee card shows where Wealthsimple is heading in credit, so Simplii should watch for impact on its card and savings propositions.

highlights.headline: BMO deploys AI Agent Assist in its Virtual Connect contact centre for credit card queries, targeting up to 30% shorter calls. Chime separately says its Jade AI agent is available to millions of members.
highlights.why: Big-bank AI is landing first in the contact centre, while neobanks put it in front of customers. Simplii should decide where an AI investment pays back fastest: cost-to-serve or member-facing help.
